name: Lusha
summary: B2B contact and company database with a Chrome extension for LinkedIn and websites: verified emails and direct dials, CRM enrichment, buying-intent signals and an API, paid in credits.
best_for: sales reps and small B2B teams who want verified emails and direct dials from a Chrome extension on LinkedIn and company sites, paid by the credit
skip_if: you mainly need phone numbers in volume (at 5 credits each they get expensive) or a full outreach and sequencing suite
honest_knock: A phone number costs 5 credits, so the credit counts on the plan cards buy far fewer phone numbers than contacts. Annual credits are granted upfront and reset at the end of the year, and plans renew automatically unless you cancel at least 14 days before the renewal date. Seats are capped per plan (1 on Starter, 2 on Pro, 5 on Premium). Lusha's data partly comes from a community programme in which members share contact details from their email headers and signatures, which matters if you sell into privacy-sensitive markets. We have not used Lusha ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month billed yearly, 4,800 credits a year granted upfront, 1 seat
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-10 on lusha.com/pricing with both billing toggles, at the credit-slider position the page opened on, USD, and on lusha.com/faq) Free is $0 with 40 credits a month, 1 seat and no credit card. Starter is $49.90 a month billed monthly with 400 credits a month, or $37.45 a month billed yearly with 4,800 credits a year granted upfront; 1 seat, adding lookalikes, bulk enrichment, the AI assistant and 5 buying-intent topics. Pro is $69.90 monthly with 600 credits a month, or $52.45 a month yearly with 7,200 credits a year; 2 seats included, adding API access, CSV enrichment, signals and webhooks. Premium, marked most popular, is $399.90 monthly with 3,400 credits a month, or $299.95 a month yearly with 40,800 credits a year; 5 seats, team management and credit allocation. Scale is a custom annual plan with SSO, 25 buying-intent topics and what the page calls 50%+ off the price per credit. Paying yearly is labelled 25% off. The FAQ prices the credits: a verified email costs 1 credit, a phone number 5 and company information 1; a lookup with no match costs nothing. Through the API a request costs 1 credit per up to 25 results plus the data revealed. Data Waterfall, on Pro and above, costs 2 credits for an email and 8 for a phone when it finds one. On the monthly Pro and Premium cards unused credits roll over up to twice the monthly amount; annual credits arrive upfront and reset at the end of the year. Plans renew automatically at the then-current price, and the FAQ says to cancel at least 14 days before the renewal date.

sessions.what: We tried to sign up for Lusha's free account on 6 November 2026. Daan filled in the e-mail sign-up form and Lusha refused it, so we never had a working account. Nothing below is a finding about the product itself.
findings: After 'Get started' the form showed a red message: 'This signup looks suspicious. Please contact support if you think there is a mistake.' No account was created.
The only other route on the page was to sign in with Google or Office 365. We did not take it.
Chrome was under automation at that moment, and that may have triggered the filter. We do not know the cause. We did not retry, did not try a workaround and did not write to support.
